description: Get a focused reading for ONE specific divination system from the 26. Pass the chart input plus a system slug (bazi, vedic, western, ninestar, thai, numerology, humandesign, mayan, celtic, saju, tibetan, ziwei, onmyodo, hellenistic, norseRune, ogham, arabicParts, kabbalistic, zoroastrian, aztec, nativeAmerican, ifaYoruba, aboriginal, biorhythm, vedicMahadasha, thaiBrahmin). Returns the raw per-system output from the engine. The side-by-side view of all 26 systems is on mythsensus.com.

location.description: Optional birthplace — city name (typo-tolerant, Thai or English) or "lat,lon", resolved offline. Explicit lat/lon override it.

system.description: System slug (typo-tolerant — common aliases and small misspellings auto-correct, e.g. "vedik"→vedic). See list_26_systems for canonical slugs.

time_known.description: Set false when birth time is unknown (default: inferred from whether hour is provided).

name: get_deep_reading
